headline: Pedro Sánchez urges application of the Housing Law to limit the weight of tourist use
summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez urged application of the Housing Law to limit tourist use of housing. He called for governing the market and did not refer to a housing decree under negotiation.
why: Housing rules affecting tourist rentals influence residential property supply, prices and the returns of short-term rental operators in Spain.
